title: Design System: Who Buys Junk Cars Near Me

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards and the lead form.

shadows.name: shadow-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for interactive grid tiles.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Single authored hero entrance moment; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA button, gold with a colored glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.8rem 1.6rem; font-size: 0.95rem; background-color: #f59e0b; color: #1f1204; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5); transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #d97706; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -8px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lead Form Card
components.html: Get A Free Quote
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 1rem; background: #ffffff; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -15px rgba(11, 23, 52, 0.25); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #0b1734; } .ds-label { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #16213e; margin: 1rem 0 0.35rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1.5px solid #e2e6f0; background-color: #f8fafc; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #16213e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f59e0b; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); }

components.name: Grid Tile Link
components.description: State/city/brand grid link tile with hover lift.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #d7deee; background: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #172a4a; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: #fbbf24; color: #d97706; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 24px 55px -12px rgba(11, 23, 52, 0.32); }

narrative.overview: A lead-generation site for a nationwide junk-car buying service, competing in a category where most sites look thin or templated. Deep navy carries institutional trust; one warm gold accent stands in for cash and marks the single action that matters per screen. Real webfonts replace the prior system-font fallback, and every decorative shortcut (eyebrow labels, unicode-glyph icons, invented section numbering) was removed in favor of typographic hierarchy doing the work.
keyCharacteristics: Real webfonts (Space Grotesk display + Inter body)
No fabricated imagery or unicode-glyph icons
One authored entrance motion, not scattered per-section fades

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is reserved for calls to action and small live-state marks. It never fills a large surface except the CTA band itself.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label sits above a heading anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Real Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow always has offset and blur; no hard flat-drop shadow or zero-offset colored halo.

dos: Do keep gold reserved for actions and live state.
Do give every heading a gold underline mark or nothing at all.
Do use the authored SVG icon set for anything that needs a glyph.
Do keep only real facts as trust claims — never invent a stat or testimonial.
donts: Don't reintroduce an eyebrow/kicker label above any H1 or H2.
Don't use a Unicode checkmark, star, or emoji as a stand-in icon.
Don't add a hard offset shadow or a one-sided colored border accent.
Don't change any route, slug, or the lib/leadForm.ts field names/ids.
